title: Mandaue City deploys 823 personnel for Kalag-Kalag

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — A total of 823 personnel from various agencies will be deployed across Mandaue City from October 31 to November 3 to ensure public safety during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. The send-off ceremony was held on Wednesday morning, Oct. 28, and included the blessing of police equipment, vehicles, and other assets to be used during the Kalag-Kalag deployment. Mandaue City Police Office (MCPO) Director Police Col. Cirilo Acosta Jr. said more than 400 police personnel will be deployed, along with personnel from the Armed Forces of the Philippines, Bureau of Fire Protection, […]...
